name: Aqaba Underwater Military Museum

sources.title: Phys.org (AFP) — Fish tanks: Jordan sinks military hardware for underwater museum (2019)

notes: Built by code (model_sources/L2_aqaba_military_museum.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/placekit.py) with AI assistance. Off Aqaba's South Beach, Jordan, sunk in 2019 as an artificial reef: tanks, armoured troop carriers, anti-aircraft guns, two cranes, an ambulance and an attack helicopter laid out in a battle formation along the reef over some 140 m. The model sets them on flat ground at about 22 m (they lie at 15-28 m along the slope); the types, number and places of the vehicles are approximate. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
